name: Royal Noxis Inspired by Clive Christian 1872 | Luxury Men’s Perfume
description: Royal Noxis, inspired by the iconic Clive Christian 1872, is a refined and luxurious men’s perfume crafted for those who appreciate true sophistication. It opens with a fresh burst of bergamot and pineapple, offering a clean and uplifting citrus-aromatic introduction. As the fragrance develops, elegant floral and herbal tones emerge, creating a smooth, classic masculine heart. Finally, the base reveals deep cedarwood, patchouli, and refined woody notes, adding long-lasting richness and a timeless gentleman’s aura. Moreover, the premium perfume-oil concentration ensures impressive longevity and projection throughout the day. Whether worn at the office, evening events, or formal occasions, Royal Noxis embodies confidence, elegance, and premium craftsmanship—exclusively from Scents by Aamir. Features Top Notes: Bergamot, Pineapple, Citrus Accords Heart Notes: Herbal Notes, Floral Accords Base Notes: Cedarwood, Patchouli, Woody Notes Longevity: 8–10 hours (Long-Lasting) Occasion: Ideal for office, formal events, and everyday luxury wear Why Choose Royal Noxis? Inspired by the luxurious Clive Christian 1872 Crafted with a high perfume-oil concentration for strong projection A premium masculine scent at an affordable price Exclusive to Scents by Aamir in Pakistan
